author: Mark Atwood
text: worker7 timebox analysis (released unclaimed, no commit — the failing sites cascade past a 15-min slice). ROOT CAUSES mapped: (1) send_dis/send_dao/gateway wire dst used ipv6_eui64(addr) or addr[8..16] as the IID — dead post-i72x.2; FIXED in my working tree: dio_dis_destination_is_allowed now gates on local_control_addr (receive.rs:131/137/329), DIS/DIO unicast admission re-targets or fails closed (transmit.rs send_dis), and secure control responses source from local_control_addr (secure.rs:61,158) so the OSCORE sender-IID binding holds. (2) GatewayCoordinator slices info.iid[8..16] as the identity IID at 3 sites (resources.rs:1826,1940,2111; gateway.rs:1154,1211) — dead invariant; I added own_identity_iid + set_identity_iid + own_iid() to resources.rs and wired set_identity_iid(root_iid) in gateway.rs (Gateway::new*/new_persistent). (3) sender_is_authorized (lichen-rpl routing.rs:729) and the DAO transit parent naming need a SPEC decision: transit parent is the parent's link-local control addr (fe80::+IID) while parent_map keys are routable — assemble_path_from's IID aliasing (routing.rs:1690s) is dead. (4) node.rs DAO dispatch + tests use routable source where spec 09 13.3 control source is link-local. STALE CORPORA still blocking: dao_origin_signature.json (52 vectors embed native source/dodag). Remaining failures at timebox: lichen-node lib 5 fail (node::tests DAO forwarding x2, rpl_stack root_dispatch/multicast_dio/three_rpl_stacks/dao_radio_failure/leaf_send_allocates), lichen-gateway end_to_end 3 fail (runtime_ingress handoff x2 + slot_claim), lichen-rpl lib 1 fail. All are the same IID-vs-routable family. The coherent slice worth landing first: the receive.rs/transmit.rs/secure.rs control-address fixes + resources.rs own_iid wiring (tests flip green only after the corpora + transit-parent decision land). Patch at /tmp/opencode/a763-analysis.diff on worker7 (not committed — partial state).
